text:
Situation: Rifampin injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-02-17 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Our three sites hold 11 to 29 days of supply across multiple presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2021-02-17. The product label for NDC 63323-351-20 names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1123748 at that plant ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-05-22. A second OAI inspection (1174894) ended 2022-06-30, with a classification letter dated 2024-04-30. The most recent inspection (1216183) ended 2023-08-24 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Inventory is low and the shortage is longstanding. The rule‑selected best option is to purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires buyer approval.
2. Pharmacist to verify and dispense Rifampin 600 mg/10mL from Mylan Institutional LLC per existing approval by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2026-06-26 — requires pharmacist approval.
3. Pharmacist to verify and dispense RIFAMPIN 600 mg/1 from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC per existing approval by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-09-01 — requires pharmacist approval.

Not recommended: No additional clinical changes or alternative sourcing beyond the three options above.
